اشترعتا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَعَتَا (ištaraʕatā) /iʃ.ta.ra.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# اُشْتُرِعَتَا (ušturiʕatā) /uʃ.tu.ri.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
